overview: In FRM-like/1, novaSine initializes z = pixel. Each loop defines denom = cos(z); when its squared real-and-imaginary size is below 1e-10 it keeps z, otherwise it assigns z - sin(z)/denom + 0.18*c. The pinned julia profile uses 96 iterations.
mathSummary: initializes z = pixel; each iteration defines denom = cos(z), keeps z unchanged when real(denom)*real(denom)+imag(denom)*imag(denom) < 1e-10, otherwise assigns z - sin(z)/denom + 0.18*c; bailout is |z - zPrev| >= 0.000001.

sourceWalkthrough.explanation: Branch: loop/1 keeps z when denom has squared size below 1e-10; otherwise it assigns z - sin(z)/denom + 0.18*c.

syntaxFeatures.explanation: The cited annotations connect initialization from pixel, the denom = cos(z) loop assignment, and the change-based bailout.
The cited branch keeps z for a squared denom size below 1e-10; otherwise it applies z - sin(z)/denom + 0.18*c.

steps: Use the pinned julia profile with all controls fixed. Run 48 iterations and then 96 iterations, and record whether the denom guard or the z - sin(z)/denom + 0.18*c update changes the observed iteration counts.
parameterExperiment.expectedObservation: The larger cap may expose additional guarded or unguarded updates; record whether the iteration counts differ.

exercise.prompt: State the two outcomes of the cos(z) denominator-size guard.
exercise.completionCheck: Your response names all 4 annotations and gives both keeping z and the sine update.
